description:
Look up property areas (city, suburb, urbanisation, or a group of
areas such as a region or a coast) by free-text name. Returns up to
10 matches with id, name, type, the parent province/city and the
number of listings, biggest first, so a group that covers a whole
region (e.g. 'Region of Murcia') comes before the city of the same
name. A country or region name (Portugal, Algarve) is answered by
the group of that name, never by villages that only share its
letters. Each match names the municipality it sits in, which tells
apart places that share a name (El Limonar in Mijas, Málaga and in
Torrevieja, Alicante). Use this to resolve place names before calling
search_properties, especially for common spellings like
'Nueva Andalucia' (vs 'Nueva Andalucía') or 'Marbella old town',
and pass the chosen id to search_properties as location_id.

provinces.description: Optional comma-separated province ids to scope the search.

search_type.description: Market the listing counts and the ranking are for. Defaults to 'for-sale'.

name: autocomplete_location

areas_in_group.description: For a group: how many areas it is made of.

id.description: Area id: pass it to search_properties as location_id.

kind.description: The raw area level, kept for existing callers; read type instead.

listings.description: Live listings in it for the search_type asked for.

municipality.description: The municipality it is part of; absent when we cannot place it, never guessed.

parent.description: The area this one sits in.

type.description: What kind of place it is; a group is a region or a coast made of other areas.

title: Autocomplete location
